content.text: St John's College What we offer About St John's College Upcoming Events Scholarship WorkshopPlanning to apply for SJC scholarships this year, but are unsure of where to start? Registrar, Sherry Peters is hosting scholarship workshops designed to help you feel confident and prepared to submit a strong application!To make things flexible, we're offering four sessions:In-Person WorkshopsTuesday, March 31st | 2:30 PM - 4:30 PM in Room 201Monday, April 6th | 2:30 PM - 4:30 PM in Room 201Online Workshops Wednesday April 8th | 5:00 PM - 7:00 PMThursday, April 16th | 5:00 PM - 7:00 PM Reading and Writing in Times of GriefSupported by the Faculty of Arts, St John's College is hosting a gathering of poets and community members to consider the ways reading and writing can be a source of comfort in times of great loss.Date: March 31st, 2026Time: 9:00 AM - 2:30 PMLocation: Cross Common Room (Room 108 St John's College)Learn more and register for this event SJCSA Graduation DinnerJoin SJCSA for an elegant evening celebrating the achievements of our graduating class. This special night will feature a delicious three-course meal, a lively photobooth to capture memories, and music throughout the evening.
